title: TEST CARD: O2 trim AICFG112 — force manual M.0103

scenarios.title: Cold start: AICFG112 is forced to MANUAL
scenarios.drawing: M.0103 = OR( |SI0014 − SI0019| ≤ 0 % (connector 1: the low select LS of boiler master BM and the air limit SI0019 picks the limit), |SI0018 − SI0021| ≤ 0 % (connector 2: the high select picks SI0018), M.0102 = OR( NOT FICFA1081.REM, NOT M.0101 = BOILER MAIN STEAM FLOW > 220 T/H ), SIG.AB B.0671·B.0701 ). M.0103 is 1:B of the AICFG112 A/M T switch.

steps.why: FICFA1081 not in REMOTE, steam flow below 220 T/H

scenarios.title: FICFA1081 in REMOTE, steam flow above 220 T/H, no cross limit active: force clears
scenarios.drawing: M.0101 = 1 (> 220 T/H), FICFA1081.REM = 1: M.0102 = 0. BM below SI0019: the low select gives BM, the difference is not 0; SI0018 below SI0021: the high select gives SI0021, the difference is not 0. The A/M T switch holds the MANUAL leg: the operator selects AUTO.
